result.topic_en: Geometric/optical calculations with tangent differences of angles, a ratio (R+x)/(R-x), ellipse equations, and the derivation of a cubic curve y^2 = x^3/C, with accompanying sketches.

methods.what: Ratio of tangent differences set equal to (R+x)/(R-x)
Definition of a ratio M/N of tangent differences
Quadratic relation in x from the product of tangent differences
Ellipse equations, the second with semi-axis squared b^2+R^2
Derivation of a cubic curve x^3 = A(y^2+x^2), i.e. y^2 = (x^3-Ax^2)/C
Approximation of the curve for small x by a semicubical parabola
